decisions.reason: The IMU module is a low-cost addition to the modular building-block system, built on stocked components and shared firmware, so keeping the option open while demand develops costs little.
The industrial AC input module has its own page, fits the firm's move toward industrial and energy-management uses, and costs little to keep listed, so its option value is above its carrying cost.
The solid state relay module sits close to the established offer, adds to the platform's breadth at minimal extra cost, and its prospects are still unresolved after one year.

The kit only bundles existing modules, so it is cheap to keep, but kits are the easiest items to prune as resources shift to newer connectors and charging products, which makes it the most likely of the four to be dropped.
